requirements.text: The system shall feed each monthly meter reading into the billing run as charge input.
The system shall calculate charges in the billing run using the Tariff table RES-A/B COM-A.

evidence.source_span: Arrow: Tariff table RES-A/B COM-A -> Billing run (operator)

requirements.text: The system shall generate a Customer bill as the output of each billing run.
The system shall record meter readings on a monthly interval.
The system shall require each billing run to be executed by an operator.
The system shall store tariff rates for RES-A, RES-B, and COM-A.
The system shall persist each generated Customer bill.
Only authenticated users assigned the operator role shall be permitted to execute a billing run.
The system shall restrict access to a Customer bill to the owning customer and authorized operators.
The system shall validate monthly meter reading input and reject missing, non-numeric, or negative values before use in a billing run.

assumptions.A1: Billing run is labeled (operator), implying a privileged operation; authentication and role check are inferred to prevent unauthorized bill generation.
assumptions.A2: Customer bills contain private usage and billing data; ownership enforcement is inferred to prevent cross-customer disclosure even though not explicitly stated.
assumptions.A3: Billing correctness depends on meter reading values; input validation is inferred to prevent incorrect charges from malformed or out-of-range readings.
